items.reason: A gentle cleanser keeps skin clean without stripping it while you add a night active.
A starter-strength retinol at night is a good single choice for smoother-looking texture, which is your lowest scan score.
A ceramide moisturizer supports a comfortable skin barrier and moisture while skin adjusts to retinol.
Retinol makes skin more sun-sensitive, so a daily mineral SPF 50 is needed alongside it.

response.routine_note: Use the retinol 2 nights a week at first, then add nights slowly as skin stays comfortable, and wear sunscreen every morning. I left out the glycolic toner and benzoyl peroxide wash because using all three together tends to irritate and dry skin, and your acne score doesn't call for the wash, so you'll likely see better progress from one active done consistently.
